verses.text: [“] And you shall make an altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide; the altar shall be square, and three cubits its height.

segments.text: [“] And you shall make an altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide; the altar shall be square, and three cubits its height.

verses.text: And you shall make its horns on its four corners; from it shall be its horns, and you shall overlay it with bronze.

segments.text: And you shall make its horns on its four corners; from it shall be its horns, and you shall overlay it with bronze.

verses.text: And you shall make its pots for removing its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its forks, and its firepans; even all its vessels you shall make of bronze.

segments.text: And you shall make its pots for removing its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its forks, and its firepans; even all its vessels you shall make of bronze.

verses.text: And you shall make for it a grate of work of net of bronze; and you shall make on the net four bronze rings on its four ends.

segments.text: And you shall make for it a grate of work of net of bronze; and you shall make on the net four bronze rings on its four ends.

verses.text: And you shall put it under the ledge of the altar from below, and the net shall be up to the middle of the altar.

segments.text: And you shall put it under the ledge of the altar from below, and the net shall be up to the middle of the altar.

verses.text: And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

segments.text: And you shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

verses.text: And the poles shall be brought into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar, when carrying it.

verses.text: Hollow, of boards, you shall make it; as it was shown you on the mountain; so shall they make [it].

verses.text: And you shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side, southward, hangings for the court of finely woven linen, a hundred by the cubit the length for the one side.

segments.text: And you shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side, southward, hangings for the court of finely woven linen, a hundred by the cubit the length for the one side.

verses.text: And its twenty pillars, their twenty bases [are] of bronze, and the hooks of the pillars and their bands [are] silver.

segments.text: And its twenty pillars, their twenty bases [are] of bronze, and the hooks of the pillars and their bands [are] silver.

verses.text: And likewise along the north side in length, hangings a hundred [cubits] long, and with its twenty pillars and their twenty bases of bronze. And the hooks of the pillars and their bands [are] of silver.

verses.text: And along the width of the court on the west side, hangings of fifty cubits, with their ten pillars and their ten bases.

verses.text: And the width of the court on the east side toward the sunrise [is] fifty cubits.

verses.text: And the hangings on one side [are] five [and] ten cubits, [with] their three pillars and their three bases.

verses.text: And for the gate of the court [is] a screen twenty cubits [long], of blue and purple and scarlet yarn and finely woven linen, the work of a weaver; [with] its four pillars and its four bases.

verses.text: And you shall command the sons of Israel, and they shall bring to you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to cause the lamp to burn continually.

verses.text: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil that [is] over the Testimony, Aaron and his sons shall arrange it from evening until morning before the face of YHWH; [it shall be] a statute forever for their generations with the sons of Israel.
